sentences.en: In the village they spoke about Juha in the evening.

sentences.ar: אחד אמר: הוא לא יעמוד בקור.
sentences.en: One said: he will not stand the cold.
Juha said: I will indeed stand it.
They said: then we shall make a bet.

sentences.ar: הם אמרו: תעמוד לילה שלם בחוץ.
sentences.en: They said: stand a whole night outside.

sentences.ar: הם אמרו: בלי אש ובלי מעיל.
sentences.en: They said: without fire and without a coat.

sentences.ar: הם אמרו: ואם תצליח, נבשל לך.
sentences.en: They said: and if you succeed, we shall cook for you.
Juha said: I agree to that.
He stood all night in the field.
It was very cold, and he trembled.
In the morning he came to them.
He said: I stood, and I am here.
They asked: did you see anything at night?
He said: I saw a light far away.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: היה שם נר בחלון.
sentences.en: He said: there was a candle in a window there.

sentences.ar: הם צעקו: אז היה לך חום!
sentences.en: They shouted: then you had warmth!
They said: you lost the bet.
Juha invited them to a meal.
They came hungry in the evening.
They sat and waited a long time.
In the end they went into the kitchen.
The pot hung very high.

sentences.ar: נר קטן עמד על הרצפה מתחתיו.
sentences.en: A small candle stood on the floor beneath it.

sentences.ar: ג'וחא אמר: הנר מבשל, כמו אתמול.
sentences.en: Juha said: the candle is cooking, like yesterday.
